thread:
alex: Heads-up — validator rejects for structured toolcalls spiked on /internal/billing. Reject rate ~5.8% last 45m. Root cause looks like `meta` is arriving as an array (expecting object). sample pasted.

maria: Oof. Can you drop the exact payload and which service image? Need to triage quickly.

alex: sample: 
```json
{
  \"transaction_id\": \"txn_9a8\",
  \"amount_cents\": 4500,
  \"meta\": [
    {\"key\": \"env\", \"value\": \"staging\"}
  ]
}
```

watchdog-bot: Canary deploy 1768601200 to svc/internal-billing (billing:0.9.4) finished :rocket:

sam: Canary aligns with the window. My hunch — client serialization change. Our contract is `meta: object | null`. Array breaks strict validator. If we flip to permissive we avoid immediate customer errors.

jin: Telemetry: current sampling for fncall payload capture is 0.5% globally. We rarely ingest full examples. Proposal: add lightweight context fields to validator events (route_id, client_id, model_variant) and capture an explicit `X-RW-CONTEXT` header so traces can join. Also recommend increasing route-level sampling to 2% for this route.

lena: Console UX: can we expose per-route "capture" with a simple slider (off, 0.1%, 1%, 2%, 10%) plus a one-click "capture now" button for on-demand higher fidelity while debugging? Also surface last 5 raw samples with automated redaction.

pat: Short-term plan: enable permissive fallback for billing route for 12h, bump capture to 2%, and alert on rejects > 2%. I'll open an incident ticket and apply the fallback.

maria: Sounds good. Pat — please also check if the routing policy caused any fallbacks to the degen variant (we don't want extra quota churn).

pat: Confirmed: a handful of requests hit fallback-variant due to strict validate -> rejected path. No significant quota surge yet, but monitoring in flight.

sam: I'll add a regression test in client-libs asserting `meta` is object, and add an integration-layer schema check to catch future client regressions.

jin: Can metrics team add metric `validator.rejects_by_path_v2` (tagged by route + path + reject_reason) and a top-n chart in the validators dashboard? That'll make it easy to see hotspots.

alex: Created ticket RW-4402 and linked dashboard panels. Pat toggled permissive-mode and raised sampling. Watchdog-bot posted the deploy earlier.

maria: Follow-ups: (1) telemetry PR to enrich validator events (2) console mock for sampling slider (3) client lint PR. Assign owners and timelines in RW-4402.

lena: I'll prototype the sampling slider and the "capture now" action — mock posted to the product board.

pat: We'll let permissive-mode run ~12h and then revert unless we see client-side fix. If anyone sees rejects -> quota bump or new fallbacks, ping immediately.

alex: Thanks all. Keeping RW-4402 as the single source. If you want raw samples from the 2% cap, comment here and I'll export.
